scope: The user's report that loading works at the start felt too slow: measurement on story.knolquiz.com, the two causes found, and the approved fixes A1 (same check, less computation), A2 (remember checks per build), B1 (brotli transport copies) and B4 (real download progress). B2 (font subsetting) was measured and not done. C1 (game.zip at once) was built, measured on the live site and not shipped. Not a release judgement, a physical school device test or a screen reader test.

before.returningStart: A browser that opened one story stays on '화면 불러오는 중' for 5.2-5.7 s on the next start with no network request. One task of 4.8 s. CPU profile: about 3.0 s in orderedStoryFlowLines (sorting all cuts again for every cut through audioPreviewPath), 0.7 s copying all cuts without visibility for every edit-mode scene. Opening 선녀와 나무꾼 원작 once stores the 1,613-cut 놀스토리 edition as well, so readWorkspace builds 1,779 scenes, and the start called readWorkspace twice (once only to find the deleted work).

A1: packages/story-domain/src/legacy/story-flow.ts: orderedStoryFlowLines computes the order once per unchanged project. A cache hit needs every cut and chapter to be the same object with the same id, chapter and order; it returns a new array each time (tests/story-flow-order.test.ts, including in-place edits).
packages/runtime-core/src/audio.ts: audioPreviewPaths gives every cut's direct-jump path at once; a test compares it with audioPreviewPath for every cut of the eight built-in works.
packages/runtime-core/src/story-runtime.ts: edit mode copies the cuts without visibility only when some cut has visibility.
apps/web/lib/workspace-storage.ts: preflight passes the precomputed path; one read checks identical content once.
apps/web/components/story-workspace.tsx: the start reads the workspace once instead of twice.
changes.A2: apps/web/lib/workspace-checks.ts and readWorkspace options: key knolstory-workspace-checks-v1 holds fingerprints of works that passed in this build (one identity per build from apps/web/next.config.ts env KNOLSTORY_BUILD_ID; off in development and tests). Parsing always runs; a changed work, a new build or a malformed record runs the full check. Contract: authoring-storage-contract.md, 시작 검사 기억.
changes.B1: spikes/renpy-web/transport.py (runtime build): renpy.data.br and renpy.wasm.br at brotli 11, kept only when they decode to the exact bytes. server/operations/story-edge-worker.mjs serves them with Content-Encoding: br, Vary: Accept-Encoding and encodeBody manual when the browser accepts br and the request is not a range; otherwise, or if the copy is missing, the identity file. scripts/static-delivery-audit.py reviews a .br as its source; scripts/verify-static-deployment.py gains --expect-brotli and rejects an encoded answer to an identity request.
changes.B4: Contract event loadProgress (protocol 1, optional, before ready). spikes/renpy-web/bridge.js counts received bytes of renpy.wasm and game.zip on a response clone and renpy.data through XHR progress, against the decoded sizes the runtime build writes into index.html, weighted by estimated transfer size. The host merges values forward only and StoryLoading shows '무대 자료를 받고 있어요 · N%' with a progressbar, then '무대를 열고 있어요' without a number. DESIGN.md 무대 준비의 진행률. A Chromium experiment (.cache/perf-check/xhr-units.spec.ts) showed XHR progress counts decoded bytes and reports no total for a brotli response, which is why the bridge counts against decoded sizes.

b2Measurement.font: NotoSansKR.ttf is a variable font (wght axis), 10,414,588 bytes, 24,964 glyphs, 23,174 mapped characters: 11,172 Hangul syllables, 8,653 Hanja, 451 Hangul jamo, 205 kana, 2,449 symbols, 244 Latin.
b2Measurement.subset: Keeping Latin, punctuation, symbols, jamo and all 11,172 Hangul syllables (fontTools 4.60.2) leaves 15,166 glyphs and shrinks the zip-deflated font from 5,345,299 to 1,986,137 bytes: 3.36 MB less, about 15% of the first download after B1.
b2Measurement.decision: Not done. Hanja would render as missing glyphs in any work that uses them, and the saving is a third of what B1 saves. Left for the user to ask for later.

firstStoryOpen.whyNotMore: game.zip (13.2 MB, unchanged) is requested only after renpy.wasm has arrived (renpy-pre.js loadGameZip after the wasm instantiates). With the copies the wasm arrives at 9-13 s, and then game.zip downloads alone for 12-16 s (about 0.8-1.2 MB/s). Without the copies renpy.data and game.zip shared the connection and the total rate was higher (about 1.3 MB/s against 0.9-1.0 MB/s), so the saved bytes did not turn into the same share of time. game.zip is now the critical path.

c1EarlyGameZip.userDecision: 2026-11-01: the user asked to do item 2 of the handoff report (C1, start game.zip together with the runtime files) and to leave the Kakao login check for later ('카카오 로그인 쪽은 아직 안하고, 2번 작업을 너가 해줘').
c1EarlyGameZip.change: Branch kiro/c1-early-game-zip, commit d0edbf2 (on GitHub, not merged, not deployed). spikes/renpy-web/bridge.js starts the plain request for window.gameZipURL when it loads, reads a clone to the end (the download continues before anyone reads it, and B4 counts its bytes), and hands the original response to the engine's first plain request for that URL. A failed early request lets the engine make its own request. renpy-pre.js is unchanged. spikes/renpy-web/bridge.test.ts: 4 new tests (hand-over without a second request and progress before the engine asks, fallback after a failure, no hand-over for another URL or a request with options, early start without sizes and no progress); 23 of 23 pass.
c1EarlyGameZip.firstExperiment: An init script that was meant to start game.zip inside the runtime frame ran only for the frame's initial about:blank document, not for /runtime/ (Pages answers /runtime/index.html with 308 to /runtime/), so it changed nothing (23:41-23:46 KST, 2026-10-31).
c1EarlyGameZip.measurement: measurement/ab-bridge.spec.ts on story.knolquiz.com, 2026-11-01 00:36-00:40 KST, ABBAABBA, empty disk profile each run, only knol-bridge.js answered from a local file through the same Playwright route in both modes (A: deployed bridge c09f977ab9d35139, B: this change d74ebc67d85aafd8). live-ab-early-game.json.
c1EarlyGameZip.result: A (as deployed): 27.6, 25.6, 30.2, 22.0 s, mean 26.4 s. B (game.zip at once): 26.5, 38.2, 26.7, 27.1 s, mean 26.8 s without the 38.2 s run (29.6 s with it). In B game.zip started at 0.8-1.1 s instead of 9.7-13.4 s, but renpy.wasm and renpy.data then finished 2-5 s later and the last runtime byte arrived at about the same time. Total throughput from the first to the last runtime byte was 0.85-1.23 MB/s in A and 0.92-0.95 MB/s in B (0.62 MB/s in the outlier). All requests share one connection, so on this line the total rate is the limit, not the order. Progress events never decreased in all 8 runs and ended with ratio 1 and start.
c1EarlyGameZip.correction: The earlier reading in liveAfterDeploy.firstStoryOpen.whyNotMore (a higher total rate with two parallel downloads) did not hold up: in this same-time run the rate did not depend on how many files downloaded at once.
c1EarlyGameZip.decision: Not shipped: no gain on this line, and it holds up to 13.5 MB in memory until the engine reads it. Kept on the branch for a fast line with a slow CPU (school network, Chromebook), where game.zip might wait for the wasm compile; not measured.
c1EarlyGameZip.onThisLine: Only fewer bytes shorten the first open. Largest compressed parts of game.zip (13,306,261 bytes in 1,076 entries): game/NotoSansKR.ttf 5.38 MB (B2), renpy/common 2.70 MB (of it TwemojiCOLRv0.ttf 0.82 MB, DejaVuSans.ttf 0.38 MB, DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf 0.35 MB), game/assets 1.86 MB (of it pixabay/291098.mp3 0.48 MB), _placeholders/assets 1.13 MB, game/cache 0.61 MB. Whether any of these can leave the first download is not examined.

byteCandidates.placeholders: Ren'Py web shows a 1/32 PNG placeholder until a progressive image has arrived (SDK renpy/display/im.py: DownloadNeeded, then _placeholders/<path> decoded as 'use_png_format.png'), so on a slow line a new picture is blurry for about its download time (the 464 KB first background about 0.5 s at 1 MB/s).
byteCandidates.font: game/NotoSansKR.ttf is 5,382,314 bytes in game.zip. Ren'Py uses the 'regular' instance when no instance is given (SDK doc/text.html, Variable Fonts), and the presenter sets no instance, axis or bold (0 matches). A static instance at wght 400 (fontTools instancer) keeps all 23,174 characters and is about 3.02 MB deflated. Pillow/FreeType at 48 px against the variable font's Regular: Hangul advances identical (920 units); 43 of 12,861 ink pixels differ by more than 32 of 255. Bold text would then need a separate file; none is used today. Also dropping the Hanja outside KS X 1001 (keeps 4,885 Hanja and 205 kana, 19,493 characters): about 2.27 MB. The built-in works contain 5 distinct Hanja in 8 places, all in catalog.json and tests, none in story text. Verification still needed in Ren'Py itself: native screenshots and the pagination checks.
byteCandidates.placeholderSize: 432 placeholders, 1.13 MB in game.zip. Saved again as PNG with 64 colours: 0.40 MB; 32 colours: 0.31 MB. They must stay PNG because Ren'Py decodes them as PNG.
byteCandidates.audioInZip: 48 audio files, 1.85 MB, kept in game.zip for an immediate first play (largest pixabay/291098.mp3 483 KB, night.wav 311 KB). Any change goes through the audio delivery policy (progressive_download.txt, audio-service-approvals.json).
byteCandidates.images: 449 images, 152.8 MB under apps/web/public/assets (421 legacy images 149 MB: 202 characters 800x1200, 216 backgrounds 1600x900 or 1599x900). Encoding: 219 lossy VP8, 122 lossless VP8L, 80 VP8X with alpha. Re-encoding test (Pillow WebP, method 6): backgrounds at quality 80 are 56-58% of the current size with PSNR 34.5-35.2 dB, at quality 90 90-97%; a lossless pixel-art character of 729 KB becomes 216 KB at lossy quality 90 but with PSNR 28.9 dB (visible damage). Changing images is an art-quality decision and changes asset hashes and provenance records.
byteCandidates.engine: renpy.wasm (4.19 MB br) and renpy.data (3.75 MB br) come from the pinned Ren'Py SDK; not a candidate without an SDK review.

followUps: C1 is measured and not shipped (c1EarlyGameZip). Next step only if wanted: measure it on a fast line with a slow CPU, or with network and CPU throttling on a local candidate.
B2 stays not done (user decision). Its 3.36 MB is about 3 s on this line (about 1 MB/s total), but Hanja would disappear from any work.

The stage loading overlay lets about 3% of the runtime frame show at its edges: its outer gradient stop is var(--story-menu-bg), rgba(17,34,35,.97). Ren'Py's own 'Downloading ...' box and the runtime page's loading text are faintly visible under the host progress (live-stage-progress.png, contrast-boosted). The 2026-10-20 evidence story-loading-live-2026-10-20/actual-reader-loading.png shows the same, so it predates this change. Candidate fix: an opaque outer stop for the stage overlay. Not done.
Later story open 3.0 s against 3.6 s (single runs): run measurement/ab-later.spec.ts to settle it.
From the cutover: the user's own Kakao login and upload on story.knolquiz.com through the Worker are still unchecked.
limits: Only this Mac's line (about 1 MB/s per stream, edge NRT/HKG) and Chromium. The decoded-byte counting for renpy.data follows Chromium's XHR behaviour; Firefox and Safari were not measured. Not a school network, a target device, a screen reader check of the new progressbar or a release judgement.
